Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The whole manual carries an old content-currency date (stated in part A), so any rule here may have changed since; the freshness debt in part A covers every fact in this section.
Hard braking without antilock brakes is described here as releasing the pedal when the wheels lock and pressing again once the skid stops, while the winter driving chapter says not to pump the pedal on snow and ice; this chapter's emergency procedure is taught here (verify TN-SPEC-D-NONABS) [A01].
Rest breaks on long drives are set here at every hour or more often, while the interstate chapter says at least every two hours or about every hundred miles; this chapter's wording is taught here (verify TN-SPEC-D-BREAKS) [A04].
The yearly crash count credited to poor driving habits has no year attached, so it is held as a dated statistic (verify TN-SPEC-D-STAT) [A03].
The antilock braking illustration and its spaced-out caption were used only where the body text says the same thing; the antilock education web link was not opened or checked.
The opening clear-weather quiz is a teaching device, not a chapter sample question, and only its stated answer is taught.
